fields.Name: T105 - Create New Dashboard
fields.Description: Verifies the dashboard creation flow: clicking New Dashboard, naming it, saving, and confirming the new dashboard is created and appears in the Data Explorer Dashboards browser.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) to open the Data Explorer app, then go to its Dashboards section (route /app/data-explorer/Dashboards). Click the 'New Dashboard' button, set the dashboard name to 'Regression Test Dashboard', and save it. The success state is the new dashboard created: it either opens directly after saving, or it appears as 'Regression Test Dashboard' in the dashboards list/card view. Pages and save operations can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment - wait for the save to complete, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new dashboard creation flow was completed with the name 'Regression Test Dashboard' entered
After saving, the dashboard named 'Regression Test Dashboard' is shown - either opened in its own view/tab or listed in the Dashboards browser
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
